source.label: Where does the data come from?
source.dpm: .dpm file (dental-bridge or a Diente Azul export)
source.sheet: Excel or CSV (patients, appointments or balances)

kindHelp.appointments: For patients already in the clinic.
kindHelp.balances: What each patient owed or had in favour in the previous system.

intros.patients: Upload a spreadsheet with one patient per row and the column names in the first row. You can start from the template.
intros.appointments: One appointment per row. The patient must already be in the clinic (import them first): found by ID document, email, phone, previous patient number or full name; if none or several match, the row is left out with a warning.
intros.balances: One row per patient with their balance: positive if they owe, negative if they have credit, or two columns Owes and In favour. What they owe goes on their account as “Previous balance”; their credit, as a payment on account. The patient must already be in the clinic.

sheet.defaultProfessionalHelp: Also used when the sheet's name matches no professional.
sheet.needsWho: Assign at least one column that identifies the patient (name, ID document, email, phone or patient number).
sheet.needsDate: Assign the column with the appointment date.
sheet.needsAmount: Assign the balance column, or the Owes or In favour ones.
sheet.templateFailed: The template could not be downloaded
sheet.uploadFailed: The file could not be read
sheet.found: {rows} rows and {columns} columns. Say what each column holds; the suggestions come from their names.
sheet.dateOrderHelp: So 03/04 is not mistaken (3 April or 4 March).
sheet.needsName: Assign at least the first name or the full name.
sheet.repeated: A field is on more than one column: {fields}
sheet.convertFailed: The file could not be converted

fields.patient_number: Patient number in the previous system

export.includeDocumentsHelp: The files travel inside the .dpm. If the clinic has many (over 500 MB), export it without them.
export.title: Export the clinic
export.subtitle: Builds a .dpm file with this clinic's data, in the same format imported here: a copy, and the way to move the clinic to another Diente Azul installation.
export.sensitive: It is always encrypted with the passphrase you choose here, which the server does not keep: without it the file cannot be opened. Keep it somewhere safe and remove the file from the server once downloaded.
export.tooShort: It must be at least {n} characters.
export.failed: The export could not be started
export.none: This clinic has not been exported yet.

settingsCard.title: Data migration (dental-bridge)
settingsCard.description: Import a DPMF file produced by dental-bridge (patients, appointments, budgets, payments, documents).

page.title: Data migration
page.subtitle: Import data extracted by dental-bridge into this clinic.

upload.dropFile: Drop the .dpm file here, or click to choose one

preview.skippedTitle: Part of the file will not be imported
preview.skippedDescription: That data belongs to Apps that are not enabled. Enable the App in Settings → Apps and run the import again to bring it in; what was already imported is not duplicated.
preview.title: Preview
preview.verifactuHelp: Preserves legal hashes (Verifactu) on invoices. Only available when the Verifactu module is installed and the file contains that data.
preview.warning: This action cannot be undone. Review the data before confirming.

filters.title: Professional filtering
filters.description: Filtered staff are imported as inactive (kept for historical references but hidden from the agenda). You can reactivate them later in Settings → Users.
filters.minActivityHelp: Soft-deactivate professionals with no clinical trace newer than this many months. Set 0 to disable.
filters.excludeOrphans: Exclude agenda-only columns without a real collaborator record
filters.excludeInactive: Exclude professionals marked as inactive in the source
filters.excludeNonClinical: Import only dentists and hygienists (skip auxiliaries and admin staff)

proposals.title: Review catalog mappings
proposals.subtitle: Link each Gesdén treatment to the Diente Azul catalog before importing.
